chapter: Biddle, Durham and early road shows
title: Buying a trumpet and playing in a band in Helena, then Biddle University
summary: With no piano at home he bought a trumpet, played in a Helena town band around 1916 and entered Biddle University in 1917.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: left the school -- this was grammar school, as you know.

And when I'd go home there wasn't any piano there, unfortunately, so I bought me a trumpet. And by knowing music I just bought me a trumpet and started studying a trumpet. All I had to do was get the fingering, because I know music on the piano, see. Because I used to sit and write music all the time, all right, so I started to playing the trumpet and I played the trumpet in the band.
This was the [E Tyler] band around in Helena, Arkansas.
This was in -- this was during the time of World War I, because my brother -- he got shipped out to the Army pretty soon after this. Around in 1916, somewhere like that.
I was about 17 year old boy.
Were you still in high school then?
Yes, I was getting ready to -- yes, I -- when did I go to college? I went to college at an early age -- 1917, 1918 -- I was 19 years old. I went to Biddle.
